body:
Maintainer request from #1452 ("We should be able to load DXF file to do profile cuts on.").

Depends on #1862 and #1863.

## Goal
Let `2D Contour` select DXF sketch chains or layers with per-chain side and direction overrides, refuse side compensation on open chains, and verify/post cleanly without a 3D solid mesh.

## Scope
- Extend `FeatureSel` in `crates/app/src/operation/types/sel.rs` and `crates/app/src/pick/feature_sel.rs` to resolve sketch `Chain(ChainId)` picks and a layer pick variant (`SketchLayer(String)`). Expose sketch chains and layers in MCP `list_features` and `set_operation_geometry` (`crates/app/src/mcp/pick.rs`).
- Add ray-to-curve hit testing in `crates/app/src/pick/` and support clicking sketch chains in `crates/ui/src/edge_pick.rs` plus selecting sketch layers in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/geo_page.rs`.
- Add optional additive per-chain overrides (`side: Option<ChainSide>` and `reverse: bool`, defaulting via `#[serde(default)]`) to operation selections. Bump `PROJECT_VERSION` cleanly if needed. When unset, apply the operation `Side` (`Auto` uses outer-vs-hole nesting) and `climb` defaults. Expose per-chain controls in UI (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_page.rs`) and MCP.
- Enforce open-chain safety: refuse side-compensated (`Inside`/`Outside`) cuts and control/wear compensation (`G41`/`G42`) on open chains with a clear named error naming the chain.
- Update `collect_job` (`crates/app/src/operation/job.rs`) and `material::judged_material` (`crates/app/src/operation/material.rs`) to accept `Sketch` sources with `part_solid = false`. Transform sketch chains by `Location` and setup alignment onto XY, validate heights against setup stock (refusing unresolved model heights by name), run `stock_sim`, crossing, stock-rapid, and fixture verification (`crates/sim/src/verify/engine.rs`), and skip 3D model-wall solid tangency checks when `part_solid` is false.
- Preserve exact `Arc` and `Circle` geometry through `2D Contour` so posted CL and NC emit true `G2`/`G3` arcs within tolerance.

## Done means
A DXF file with an outer rectangle, two circles, and a line-arc slot imports and cuts with `2D Contour` (outer loop outside, holes inside) into golden CL matching drawn sizes; per-chain side and direction overrides work via UI and MCP; side-compensated cuts on open chains fail by name; stock removal, crossing, rapid, and fixture checks run without a 3D model mesh.

Part of #1452
